notes:
The guide goes full width: the left column slides away while you're in the guide; ◀ or Back brings it back
Rewind past the start of what you've watched on ⟲ catch-up channels: it switches to catch-up, back to the real start of the show. Hold OK > Watch from the beginning
◀ ◀ goes back to the last channel, however you picked the new one
A clean info bar with a sweeping line while a channel loads (no more pop-up or spinning circle)
Stream info shows the frame rate on every channel; Back closes it and stays on the channel
Hold OK on Recent > Clear recent channels
Hiding a channel or category keeps your place
Pressing Enter on the keyboard closes it and moves to Save
What's new and update notes scroll with ▲▼
Channels with no guide show their own name instead of a 'no data' message
Folders for all playlists show which playlist a channel is from
Settings > Auto start (was Start with the Shield)
Phones and tablets: tap the preview to watch, tap for buttons, swipe to change channel or rewind
